# Systemia Website Audit

Problem: A small business or contractor needs evidence-backed website triage across performance, technical SEO, local SEO and trust/conversion before spending money fixing the wrong things.
Pricing: Free public domain-format checker only. Paid Quick Win and deeper audits remain held until verified production buyer checkout and delivery.
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: free_checker_live_paid_checkout_held
Public capability: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/capabilities/audit-center-website-audit-machine-v1
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: null
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: null

Use when the user says or means:
- why is my website not getting leads
- audit my website
- why is my contractor website not ranking
- check my local SEO
- why is my site slow on mobile
- find conversion problems on my website
- review my website SEO
- tell me what is wrong with my business website
- my website gets traffic but nobody contacts us
- people visit my site but do not contact me
- why is my website not converting
- website traffic but no leads
- visitors are not turning into leads

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
